issues.description: The template Lecture constructor has only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents), but the problem UML and the solution require a constructor that initializes five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected constructor signature and the correct order/number of parameters to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Lecture constructor signature to include all five parameters in the UML-specified order (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and initialize the corresponding attributes, or remove the partial constructor so students implement the full constructor themselves. This aligns the template with the problem description and the provided solution.
